descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · S06 「换日规则表：状态 × 设的日期 × 模式 → 换日后的状态，加上病历那一格（打开昨天的 New Admission）」 Day rule table: status x day set x context -> status after the roll, plus the chart cell (yesterday's New Admission opened)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U5 New Admission and Consult both roll to Follow-up on the next calendar day without the physician touching them; a status set today stays today（UAT TC-06；TFA-92584 AC 4）
  • U7 A status already changed by hand before the day rolls is not affected by the roll (step 5)（UAT TC-06；TFA-92584 AC 4）
  • U12 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (step 7, ground rule 3.3)（UAT TC-06；UAT 3.3；TFA-92584 AC 7）

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given Rows seeded through the API with encType/encTypeDay (Hospital and Nursing Home); one Hospital patient seeded New Admission with yesterday's day and opened in the chart (former S08)

When Run the lifecycle with today's day; open the seeded chart

Then New Admission and Consult set on an earlier day -> Follow-up (day restarts); set today -> unchanged; Follow-up -> untouched; a hand set restarts the clock; a set without a day clears the old day; yesterday's New Admission reads Follow-up in the chart, SOAP progress is pre-selected, and the row is saved as Follow-up with today's day

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions on rounding:list / snf:list after rounding:applyLifecycle / snf:applyLifecycle, and expectStatus follow-up / Note Format soap in the chart. These pass the client's day ('yesterday' is the device day), so they prove the rule, not which clock supplies 'today' (U6 is S10, S19, S23). …

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S06 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-06.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数）（API (seed encType/encTypeDay, call rounding/snf applyLifecycle with today)）；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
